about.text: Ricotta affumicata is smoked ricotta, usually smoked over oak or chestnut; a Calabrian version comes from the Sila.

facts.v: Made from sheep's whey, in one Calabrian listing
Whey left from making other cheese, smoked a few days over wood smoke, fragrant plants and chestnuts (Upper Crotonese, Mammola)
